title: Session 3: The Lost Roads & The Raleigh Museum Infiltration - Intent Parity Contract
description: Double-blind intent and agency rules for Session 3 to prevent Hollywood heist tropification (FP-01), modern vehicle highway transit (DEC-003), and ungrounded mechanical leaks.

rules.description: Forbid raw D&D rules, dice terminology, and feature labels from leaking into novel manuscript prose
rules.fail_message: Tabletop game mechanics or dice terminology leaked into narrative prose.

rules.description: Forbid high-tech Hollywood heist tropes (FP-01). The Raleigh museum entry is an awkward academic social bluff, not an Ocean's Eleven laser-grid infiltration
rules.fail_message: Hollywood heist tropes detected (FP-01). Museum entry is grounded social bluffing, not high-tech infiltration.

rules.description: Transit to Raleigh occurs through Theodore's maintenance shed onto the metaphysical Lost Roads, never modern asphalt highway driving (DEC-003)
rules.fail_message: Unanchored modern vehicle transit detected (DEC-003). Transit must use the Lost Roads threshold.

rules.description: Adversary faction terminology must not drift from canonical names
rules.fail_message: Adversary faction terminology drifted from canonical lore.

rules.description: Raw markdown triple asterisks in novel manuscript
rules.fail_message: Raw markdown triple-asterisk formatting leaked into manuscript prose.

authorial_liberties.liberty: Staged transition through Theodore's maintenance shed into the metaphysical fog of the Lost Roads, establishing tactile sensory grounding.
authorial_liberties.impact: Preserved canonical non-vehicular transit while creating eerie threshold atmosphere.

authorial_liberties.scope: Maiden of Persephone & Metaphysical Time Warps
authorial_liberties.liberty: Novelize Ally's exposition on the non-linear temporal dilation of the Lost Roads, dramatize Alfie's longing for pancakes, and stage Ally vanishing through ancient limestone archways.
authorial_liberties.impact: Deepened mythological atmosphere while explaining the metaphysical mechanics of the transit bypass.

authorial_liberties.liberty: Staged the emergence from the Lost Roads into the Raleigh storage annex, observing the museum across the parking lot and establishing the grounded academic disguise plan.
authorial_liberties.impact: Prevented modern highway driving hallucinations while grounding the approach to the museum.

authorial_liberties.liberty: Dramatized Dravin's patrician scholarly credentials to bluff past museum reception, heightening Pierre's nervous French social anxiety.
authorial_liberties.impact: Created authentic comedic character tension without resorting to heist tropes.

authorial_liberties.liberty: Staged Pierre's melodramatic horrified theatricals over Alfie being a cursed doll to distract visitors, integrating the chaotic sheep stampede into the museum atrium.
authorial_liberties.impact: Maximized character comedic timing while providing tactical cover for the infiltration.

authorial_liberties.scope: The Research Annex & Security Guard Commotion
authorial_liberties.liberty: Choreographed security guard Thomas wrangling escaped livestock against the kiosk while Dravin deftly searches for access keys without violence.
authorial_liberties.impact: Maintained non-violent social stealth and grounded museum logistics.

authorial_liberties.scope: Epigraphy Team Infiltration & White Coat Masquerade
authorial_liberties.liberty: Staged Pierre and Dravin donning research lab coats to blend in with the visiting university epigraphers, deflecting scholarly scrutiny with classical jargon.
authorial_liberties.impact: Heightened tension through intellectual masquerade rather than high-tech espionage.

authorial_liberties.scope: Preservation Prep Room & Aegean Limestone Replication
authorial_liberties.liberty: Dramatized Pierre wheeling a utility cart into the prep room, utilizing his artistic background to evaluate the Aegean carving chisel marks.
authorial_liberties.impact: Anchored Pierre's legitimate artistic talent to the antiquities theft narrative.

authorial_liberties.scope: Security Badge Swipe & Restricted Archives Infiltration
authorial_liberties.liberty: Choreographed swiping the acquired staff keycard at the magnetic door latch to enter the restricted archives under closing-bell pressure.
authorial_liberties.impact: Delivered crisp heist tension adhering strictly to realistic institution security.

authorial_liberties.liberty: Focalized party inspection of the Greek inscription tablet, sensory alarm recognition, and tactical positioning before the impending assault.
authorial_liberties.impact: Set up the high-stakes physical climax of Session 4 Beckon/Beacon Wordcraft alteration.
